To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the developed informative tutoring system feedback forms are more efficient than the traditional feedback forms in terms of learning and motivation.

(a) informative tutoring feedback has a positive impact on learning, (b) the effects of feedback are moderated by task characteristics and (c) the effects of different feedback types depend on the type of learning task and on the type of feedback.

(a) the effects of elaborated feedback depend on the task characteristics (e.g. task difficulty, type of error) and the learner's characteristics (e.g., prior knowledge, learning style); (b) elaborated feedback is more effective if it provides information about the solution and the underlying problem-solving process; and (c) the effects of informative tutoring feedback depend on its design.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a systematic approach to designing and implementing informative tutoring feedback for multimedia learning environments.
the question of how to design and implement informative tutoring feedback forms for multi-media learning environments in order to support effective learning processes.
the design and implementation principles of informative tutoring feedback forms for multimedia learning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effects of elaborated feedback depend on several factors.
the effects of feedback are highly dependent on the type of feedback, on the task, on the learner, and on the learning context (see reviews by Kulhavy, 1977, 1982, 1989, 1991).
the design of feedback is a complex process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the design of informative feedback messages has to be considered a complex task.
the results of the two studies indicate that the effects of elaborated informative tutoring feedback on learning and motivation are not trivial and that the effects depend on the feedback type.
informative feedback is an important factor in computer based learning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of informative feedback can have a large impact on the effectiveness of learning.
the feedback we give students can make a difference in how they think about their learning.
the use of multiple feedback forms is a powerful tool for supporting the learning processes in multimedia environments.
